disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced in an office not exclusively devoted to optometry or other health care profession where non-related merchandise is displayed, or an office not conforming to professional standards in the area

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued employment with or assisting a person/firm violating Delaware optometry laws

disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 2113. Grounds for refusal, revocation or suspension of licenses.
